let active = 0;
let peak = 0;
async function work(id) {
  active += 1;
  peak = Math.max(peak, active);
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 30));
  active -= 1;
  return id * 2;
}

async function saveAll(ids) {
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    out.push(await work(ids[i]));
  }
  return out;
}

const started = Date.now();
const result = await saveAll([1, 2, 3, 4]);
const elapsed = Date.now() - started;
if (peak !== 1 || elapsed < 110) throw new Error(`peak=${peak} elapsed=${elapsed}`);
console.log(JSON.stringify({ peak, serial: elapsed >= 110, result }));
